"### Chart Description: Policy Rate and Core Inflation

The provided chart illustrates the relationship between the monetary policy rate, core inflation, and real interest rates (both ex-post and ex-ante) from November 2022 to May 2024. All values are expressed in monthly percentages (m/m).

#### Chart Components
*   **Title:** Policy Rate and Core Inflation (Percent, m/m)
*   **Y-Axis:** Percentage values ranging from -16 to 48, with increments of 8.
*   **X-Axis:** Time from Nov-22 to May-24.
*   **Legend:**
    *   **Real interest rate (ex-post):** Grey bars.
    *   **Real interest rate (ex-ante):** Yellow bars.
    *   **Policy rate (effective terms):** Light blue line.
    *   **Core inflation:** Dark blue line.
*   **Sources:** BCRA; INDEC; and Fund staff estimates.
*   **Note:** Real interest rates are derived from core inflation. The ex-ante measure is based on average expected core inflation for the current and subsequent two months (t, t+1, t+2).

#### Extracted Data (Approximate Monthly Values)

| Month | Policy Rate (Line) | Core Inflation (Line) | Real Interest Rate: Ex-post (Grey Bar) | Real Interest Rate: Ex-ante (Yellow Bar) |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| Nov-22 | ~6% | ~5% | ~1% | N/A |
| Dec-22 | ~6% | ~5% | ~1% | ~0.5% |
| Jan-23 | ~6% | ~6% | ~0% | ~0.5% |
| Feb-23 | ~7% | ~8% | ~-1% | ~0.5% |
| Mar-23 | ~7% | ~7% | ~0.5% | ~1% |
| Apr-23 | ~8% | ~8% | ~0.5% | ~1.5% |
| May-23 | ~8% | ~8% | ~1% | ~1% |
| Jun-23 | ~8% | ~6.5% | ~1.5% | ~0% |
| Jul-23 | ~8% | ~6.5% | ~1.5% | ~0% |
| Aug-23 | ~10% | ~14% | ~-3.5% | ~2% |
| Sep-23 | ~10% | ~13.5% | ~-3% | ~0% |
| Oct-23 | ~11% | ~9% | ~2% | ~0% |
| Nov-23 | ~11% | ~14% | ~-2% | ~-2% |
| Dec-23 | ~9% | ~28% | ~-15% | ~-7% |
| Jan-24 | ~8.5% | ~18% | ~-10% | ~-9% |
| Feb-24 | ~8.5% | ~12% | ~-3% | ~-6% |
| Mar-24 | ~7% | ~10% | ~-2% | ~-4% |
| Apr-24 | ~5% | ~8% | ~-1% | ~-3% |
| May-24 | ~4% | ~6% | N/A | ~-2% |

#### Key Trends
*   **Core Inflation Peak:** Inflation surged significantly, peaking at approximately 28% in December 2023, followed by a steady decline toward 6% by May 2024.
*   **Policy Rate:** The effective policy rate rose steadily to a peak of 11% in late 2023 before being reduced to around 4% by May 2024.
*   **Real Interest Rates:** Both measures turned sharply negative in late 2023 due to the inflation spike, with the ex-post rate reaching nearly -15% in December 2023. They have since begun trending back toward zero as inflation cooled."
